lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: Listen. Choose your ground first, then your enemy.

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: Close on one of them and strike. Never stand where three of them can reach you.

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: Before you swing, weigh it. Know what the blow costs them, and what it costs you.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: And if it costs too much?

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: Then you wait, and make them come to you.
